text:
samira: Quick async sync — posting sprint status for the hotpath work (kernel + continuous batching + KV improvements). TL;DR: three milestones this week, need final ownership callouts and a couple PR reviews.

samira: Milestones: 1) kernel optimizer PR merge (BOLT-312) by Fri EOD, 2) continuous-batching canary rollout to staging Mon-Tue, 3) KV prefetch heuristic tuned + perf test run Wed.

mike: On BOLT-312: I landed the perf refactor, left the kernel pin change pending. @jordan can you take the kernel pin change review? It's small but touches the sampler.

jordan: I can review today. heads-up: the change impacts cold-start trace logging, will validate regression tests.

anya: For continuous batching, infra needs the new route header to enable request grouping. I pushed a small config change to infra-configs: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/configs/723

luis: noted. I'll apply the config to staging after deploy window. Planning deploy Wed 02:00 UTC (low traffic).

samira: @mike @jordan ownership: who's primary for the kernel post-merge fallout? we need someone on rotation for any hotfixes during canary.

mike: I'll own on-call for kernel fallout through next Tue. @anya will you monitor latency SLOs for batching?

anya: Yep I'll set up an alert dashboard with the batching latency histogram and KV hit-rate. Will share links when ready.

jordan: Reviewed BOLT-312, left 2 small comments about metric naming. once that's addressed I can approve.

mike: Addressing comments now, will push patch with renames and add a brief note in PR.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. CI: 45/47 checks passed, rerun for flaky test: tests/runtime/coldstart_test

luis: After deploy I'll kick off the perf harness: run perf/hotpath/runner.sh --model tiny --iters 5 --seq 1024. Logs will be in /var/artifacts/perf/2143654321.

samira: On KV prefetch: current plan is to use age-based prefetch + popularity threshold. @mike did we settle on the threshold after offline traces?

mike: Yes — threshold at 3 hits/min rolling average for initial canary. We'll bump to 5 if we see cache churn.

anya: I'll create a short eval set to validate quality vs cost for prefetch. quick question: should we include completions that are >512 tokens? they skew latency.

jordan: Exclude >512 for the eval set. Use a separate long-tail bucket for tracking.

samira: Action items: - mike: push kernel patch + note (today) - jordan: approve BOLT-312 once comments addressed - anya: dashboard + alert (before canary) - luis: apply config + run perf harness (deploy night) - samira: coordinate rollouts and collect perf artifacts

mike: adding one more: I'll open a 2-hour blocking window in calendar for Fri in case we need a rollback for kernel changes.

anya: shared dashboard draft: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/kv-batching/overview (will grant access to runtime team)

luis: perf run queued post-deploy. ping me if you want real-time logs during the window.

samira: Thanks team. If anything blocks on reviews call it out here. Otherwise we'll reconvene after perf runs and tag owners for next actions. :thumbsup:
